story.title: Apply a discount code at checkout
story.description:
As a customer I want to apply a discount code at checkout so my total updates.

Acceptance criteria

  • A 'Discount code' input and an 'Apply' button appear on the checkout page (per the Design Link in this description).
  • Applying a valid code reduces the order total and shows 'Code applied' (EN) / 'تم تطبيق الكود' (AR).
  • Applying an invalid or expired code shows the inline error 'This code is not valid' (EN) / 'هذا الكود غير صالح' (AR) and leaves the total unchanged.
  • An empty code with Apply clicked shows 'Enter a code' and does not call the pricing service.
